_about: Mantua 1524 cipher (Vat. lat. 8214 ff. 298r-v, 68r, 198r). Units = signs with pairs merged per _merges. Grade S throughout (fitted and hand-read; no key sheet or gloss, so no H/C). value null = no reading. n = occurrences on non-reserved lines. confidence: A several independent words; B two independently secure words; W two words, one resting on an uncertain transcription or unit; C one word. Only A/B values can make a segment strict. loo = best single value by 4-gram LM with this sign freed and all others held. anneal6 = value from the round-6 anneal with all A values fixed (signs left free only).
